title: The SARDAR PATEL UNIVERSITY MANDI, HIMACHAL PRADESH (ESTABLISHMENT AND REGULATION) ACT, 2021
full_text: The SARDAR PATEL UNIVERSITY MANDI, HIMACHAL PRADESH (ESTABLISHMENT AND REGULATION) ACT, 2021 सरदार पटेल विश्वविद्यालय मंडी, हिमाचल प्रदेश (स्थापना और विनियमन) अधिनियम, 2021 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20223 Act Number: 3 Enactment Date: 2022-02-10 Act Year: 2022 Short Title: The SARDAR PATEL UNIVERSITY MANDI, HIMACHAL PRADESH (ESTABLISHMENT AND REGULATION) ACT, 2021 Hindi Title: सरदार पटेल विश्वविद्यालय मंडी, हिमाचल प्रदेश (स्थापना और विनियमन) अधिनियम, 2021 Long Title: AN ACT to establish and incorporate a University in the State of Himachal Pradesh to be known as “The Sardar Patel University Mandi, Himachal Pradesh” for the purpose of affiliating, teaching and ensuring proper and systematic instructions, training and research in the Higher Education system.
